about: The recipe of the Nalati Grasslands image-to-3D models in public/assets/nalati/models/ (M10 item 6, E315), copied read-only from ~/projects/localai (bin/img2mesh/nalati-jobs.tsv @ 9db9ffd, finish.sh, finish-all.sh) and the generation metadata under ~/ml/img2mesh/, so this repo holds every recipe for what it ships (`shipped`: the model is in the game; the yurt went procedural in 609f4242). localai keeps the runners and the model installs; this file is the settings. It is not a driftwood_post.py prop list: the Nalati post is localai's blender_post.py (textured atlas, not faceted colour), so build_props.py does not run it.
pipeline: reference: codex image_gen from the prompt below -> ~/ml/img2mesh/refs/<name>.png; cutout.py (BiRefNet) -> refs/cut/<name>.png

generate, under ~/projects/localai/bin/img2mesh/run-locked.sh (the model lock): TRELLIS.2 `trellis_batch.py --pipeline 512` (keeps the raw decode as out/t512/<name>.npz) and Hunyuan3D-2 `hy3d_batch.py --out out/hy --shape turbo`

finish (no model, no lock): `finish-all.sh <outdir> nalati-jobs.tsv` per row. TRELLIS: `trellis_rebake.py <npz> <name>.rebake.glb --faces <tris> --tex <tex>` (base colour baked from the voxel attributes), then ALIGN=<align> KEEP_UV=1 finish.sh. Hunyuan: ALIGN=<align> finish.sh on out/hy/<name>.glb (decimate, xatlas unwrap, Cycles hi->low base-colour bake)

finish.sh <name> <raw.glb> <tris> <height> <yaw> <ref.png> <outdir> 0 <tex> = `blender -b -P blender_post.py -- --in <raw> --out <name>.raw.glb --tris <tris> --tex <tex> --height <height> --yaw <yaw> --paint 0 --align <align> --remesh 0 [--keep-uv] --ref <ref> --turntable <sheet>`, then `gltf-transform optimize <raw> <name>.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size <tex> --simplify false --instance false` and the same at --texture-size 512 for <name>.phone.glb. TRELLIS takes -> ~/ml/img2mesh/final/, Hunyuan takes -> ~/ml/img2mesh/final-hy/

spruce only: `blender -b -P blender_impostor.py -- --in <work>/spruce.raw.glb --out spruce.impostor.glb --res 256`, then gltf-transform optimize --texture-compress webp --simplify false --compress false

this repo: `node scripts/nalati-models-color.mjs` matches each model's atlas to its reference (its KNOBS pick the generator per model: `ships` below), writes <name>.glb (1024^2) + <name>.phone.glb (512^2) + the herds' <name>.far.glb into public/assets/nalati/models/
this repo: `node scripts/nalati-rig-bake.mjs` -> the creatures' *.rigged.glb / *.phone.rigged.glb; scripts/img2mesh/build_faces.sh + faces.json -> people/faces-*/

props.name: yurt
props.prompt: a Kazakh yurt (kiiz ui): round white felt walls over a lattice, a low domed felt roof with a smoke ring (shanyrak) at the top, broad red-and-ochre woven ornament bands (koshkar muiiz ram-horn pattern) around the wall top and roof edge, a carved painted wooden door. Whole yurt visible, seen from slightly above

props.name: horse-saddled
props.prompt: a saddled Kazakh steppe horse: stocky chestnut horse with dark mane and tail, a wooden Kazakh saddle with a red felt saddle cloth with ornament, stirrups, bridle and reins. Standing still in a neutral side stance, all four legs straight and clearly separated, head up, tail down. Full body visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: horse-wild
props.prompt: a wild steppe horse (Przewalski type): dun coat, pale belly, short upright dark mane, dark legs and tail, no tack. Standing still in a neutral side stance, all four legs straight and clearly separated, head up. Full body visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: wolf
props.prompt: a grey steppe wolf: thick grey-brown fur, pale chest, amber eyes, bushy tail. Standing still in a neutral side stance, all four legs straight and clearly separated, mouth closed, tail relaxed. Full body visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: sheep
props.prompt: a Kazakh fat-tailed sheep: cream and light brown fluffy wool, dark brown face and ears, broad fat tail. Standing still in a neutral side stance, all four legs straight and clearly separated. Full body visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: snow-leopard
props.prompt: a snow leopard: pale smoky-grey fur with dark rosettes, very long thick tail, large paws. Standing still in a neutral side stance, all four legs straight and clearly separated, tail curving behind. Full body visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: eagle
props.note: perched, wings folded (the post was dropped); elite Qyran
props.prompt: a golden eagle (berkut) perched on a short wooden post, wings folded, dark brown plumage with golden nape feathers, yellow beak and talons, looking to the side. Whole bird and post visible, side three-quarter view

props.name: golden-king
props.prompt: the Golden King, an undead Saka warrior-king risen from a burial kurgan: a tall figure in armour of thousands of small overlapping gold plaques, a tall pointed gold headdress with gold arrow and snow-leopard ornaments, a gold belt, a short akinak sword at the hip, a gold-trimmed red cape, a gaunt shadowed face with glowing eyes. Standing upright facing forward, arms slightly away from the body, legs apart, full body visible head to feet, front three-quarter view

props.name: spruce
props.prompt: a single Tian Shan spruce tree (Picea schrenkiana): very tall and narrow columnar conifer, dense drooping dark blue-green branches in layers, straight brown trunk visible at the base only. Whole tree visible from base to tip, centred

props.name: balbal
props.prompt: an ancient Turkic balbal stone statue: a weathered grey granite standing stone about 1.5 m tall carved into a stylised warrior with a flat face, moustache, hands holding a cup at the chest, a belt with a sword, lichen patches. Whole statue visible, standing upright

props.name: boulder-1
props.prompt: one large rounded granite boulder, grey with warm ochre and green lichen patches, a few cracks, sitting flat on its base. Whole rock visible

props.name: boulder-2
props.prompt: one tall angular granite boulder with a flat top and sharp faceted sides, grey with lichen patches, sitting flat on its base. Whole rock visible

props.name: boulder-3
props.prompt: one low flat wide granite slab boulder, split in two by a crack, grey with moss and lichen, sitting flat on its base. Whole rock visible

props.name: kumis-churn
props.prompt: a Kazakh kumis churn (saba / pisspek): a tall leather mare's-milk vessel with a wooden plunger sticking out of the top, standing on short wooden legs, stitched dark leather with a red woven strap. Whole object visible

props.name: cauldron
props.prompt: a black iron cauldron (kazan) with two handles hanging from a tripod of three wooden poles tied at the top with rope, over a small ring of stones with unlit firewood. Whole object visible

props.name: saddle
props.prompt: a traditional Kazakh wooden saddle (er-toqym) on its own, high front and back pommel carved and painted with red and gold ornament, a red felt saddle cloth, leather stirrups hanging down. Resting on the ground. Whole object visible

props.name: firewood
props.prompt: a neat stack of split firewood logs, pale birch and brown pine, about 1 m long and 60 cm high, a hatchet stuck in the top log. Whole object visible

props.name: chest
props.prompt: a Kazakh wooden storage chest (sandyq): rectangular, painted deep red with ochre and blue carved ornament panels, iron corner fittings and a hasp. Lid closed. Whole object visible

merge.about: NALATI-MERGE D1 / D2 (~/ml/img2mesh/out/nalati-merge/job.sh + post.sh): cutout -> TRELLIS.2 512 (--faces 80000 --tex 2048) and Hunyuan3D-2 --shape full, then `post.sh gen <id>` = the finish above (tex 1024, yaw 0) into out/nalati-merge/final/{t,hy}/; nalati-models-color.mjs --src / --ref / --out takes the picked generator. blenderCandidateTris is the driftwood_post.py candidate the board compared (--quant 14 --simplifier fqmr), not what ships
